dedupe_keys.name: building height estimation in halle using geoclimate and machine learning

description: FAIRiCUBE publishes a GeoTIFF of estimated building heights in Halle, Germany, from the Geoclimate random-forest workflow. The provider says the model used 62 indicators derived around OpenStreetMap footprints and was trained on ground-truth heights for 14 French communes from BDTopo. Zenodo lists one public raster of about 16.7 MB under CC BY 4.0. City building-height inputs can support energy-stock, solar-shading or wind-exposure simulations when direct surveys are absent. This is a transferred model prediction, not a measured Halle height inventory. The page does not report a Halle holdout error or show how French training conditions transfer to every building type in Halle. Two other FAIRiCUBE Halle height deposits use levels and DEM differences, so their agreement is a useful check. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this named prediction layer. The raster and underlying trained model were not downloaded or run.
